messages:
marta_cs: Quick synthesis from onboarding hops today — three customers called out finance-grade chargeback + a request for smarter embedding updates. Putting a compact bucket here so product can triage before renewal outreach. React or add actions.
leo_onboard: saw this at GreenTide, Nimbus, and HelixCardio. Quote from Helix exec: 'we need a daily file, not estimates, otherwise our CFO won't accept the bill.'
devin_prod: drop the short asks + severity and I'll map to intake and LOE. If it's a renewal blocker we escalate.
marta_cs: short asks: 
1) finance webhook + export (critical) — a daily push to a customer-configured webhook containing authoritative per-route charge lines. Fields they want: date, route, env, team_tag, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_usd, invoice_id. (renewal risk: HelixCardio, GreenTide)
2) incremental embedding updates (high) — not full reindex; customers want per-document delta re-embed with a configurable confidence threshold so we avoid churn. Should support webhook or batch TTL.
3) onboarding readiness checklist (medium) — a Console checklist tied to test dataset health (example: sample queries, example latency under 200ms).
4) quick mitigation template (low) — short email + console screenshot we can send to buyers during renewal conversations.
samira_eng: Qs: for finance webhook do they expect invoice parity (exact billing calc) or reconciliable aggregates? Also what volume for incremental re-embed?
marta_cs: They asked for invoice parity or a documented, auditable calculation so finance can reconcile. Re-embed volume is low for pilots (~<50 docs/day) but could be higher in prod.
devin_prod: Proposed triage: 
- P0: finance webhook/export for renewals <6w. We can prototype a daily aggregator and webhook.
- P1: incremental embedding API + small scheduler.
- P2: Console checklist + mitigation template.
samira_eng: Implementation idea: expose an endpoint `POST /cs-webhooks/:orgId/chargeback` where customers register a URL and a signing key. Backend runs daily aggregator job and POSTs newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) with each line as a charge row. Sample line: `{"date":"2026-02-20","route":"/v1/generate","env":"prod","team":"billing","model":"rwd-v1","tokens_in":12345,"tokens_out":6789,"cost_usd":"12.34","invoice_id":"inv_20260220_01"}`
leo_onboard: love that. Also for incremental re-embed maybe allow `confidence_threshold` param so we only re-embed docs with embedding drift > X. Customers framed it as "reduce noise but keep freshness."
devin_prod: Action items: 
- @samira_eng: prototype ndjson webhook & sample schema (ETA 3d).
- @leo_onboard: attach two verbatim quotes from HelixCardio & GreenTide to new GH triage issue.
- @marta_cs: add HelixCardio + GreenTide to renewal tracker as high-risk and draft a mitigation email (use quick template).
audit_bot: Notice: New GH issue created -> cs/feedback #1429 (product-triage) by marta_cs. Thread auto-linked.
samira_eng: I'll also draft an incremental re-embed API: `POST /datasets/:id/reembed?policy=delta&threshold=0.12` and a small worker to compute cosine delta. Posting a design doc link in the GH issue.
devin_prod: I'll pick this up in Tuesday triage. If the webhook prototype looks low-effort we can schedule a small scoped spike. Adding to CS/Product sync agenda.
marta_cs: thanks all — if we can get the ndjson sample + a 1-slide LOE we can include the mitigation in renewal outreach. Adding thread to agenda. :thumbsup:
